notes: Room-agnostic native RLR simulation profile for m6x RIR cache rendering.
Supersedes reuse of the historical M4 canary request for production caches.

Changes against the M4 canary simulation block: indirect_ray_depth 100 -> 200 (RLR engine default), direct_sh_order 1 -> 3 (RLR adapter default; sharper direct-path spatialization), transmission false -> true (matches SoundSpaces 2.0 training configuration; interior partitions become acoustically transmissive instead of perfectly opaque).
Rendering stays at 16 kHz deliberately: the dataset audio contract is 16 kHz and azimuth cues below 8 kHz are preserved; this is a declared bandwidth bound, not an accident.
This profile is a propagation-quality setting only; it makes no physical room-material or calibration claim.
